name: ferrarilabs-site-tooling
description: Dev/audit tooling ONLY. The site itself stays framework-free and build-free (see docs/bolao/adr/ADR-001-vanilla-javascript.md) — GitHub Pages serves the HTML/CSS/JS as-is and never reads this file. It exists so the browser-based audit suites are reproducible instead of depending on whatever Playwright happened to be installed on a given machine.
